items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: somebody told me that the guy in front of the band wasn't Chick Webb; his name was Bardu Ali.

ctx.x: But all of this was very fascinating to me. And I was kind of torn between watching this lady, or trying to approach this young lady on my first date and what was going on up there on the stage, and listening to the band, and trying to listen to what the piano player was playing.

Anyway, I liked that. So the next week, I found myself up there to hear Chick Webb. I heard Chick Webb's band, and I never will forget... I thought that the guy who was standing in front of the band was Chick Webb. And for a long time, it was quite a while, that somebody told me that the guy in front of the band wasn't Chick Webb; his name was Bardu Ali. At that particular time, all the bands had some character standing up there waving a stick in front of the band, and a lot of times it was not the bandleader who…

I enjoyed listening to it. But there was so much going on, you didn't know where to really center your attention. At that particular time, I guess I was so I guess enchanted with everything that was going on on the stage, that I didn't settle in on any one instrumentalist. I always did try to
